name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a Nevada-focused natural resource company operating a three-part business model: mineral royalty creation and acquisition, precious-metals exploration streaming and financing, and an exploration project accelerator. The company holds a strategic land position and royalties across multiple projects in Nevada's highest-grade historical mining districts, including the Walker Lane shear zone and Carlin Trend. Nevada Canyon is in the exploration stage with properties including the Loman, Agai-Pah, and Belshazzar projects.
